description: Land Acquisition - Pangollamada, Akurana D/S Division, Kandy District
categorisation: This gazette content is a declaration under the Land Acquisition Act for the acquisition of specific land parcels (Lots A, B, and C) described with detailed boundaries and extents for a public purpose. The content focuses exclusively on land acquisition matters, including property descriptions, boundaries, and ownership claims, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
